verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents 'global code search' to locate code snippets and navigate repositories. Community users report browsing code on the phone, though one notes that in-repo readme links fail on iOS. Nothing in the evidence shows fuzzy matching, search filters, or regular-expression support, which are the specific elements the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of fuzzy matching, documented search filters/qualifiers, regex search support, and independent corroboration of mobile code search depth.
